blockers.detail: Even with the cost-aware filter (best validation-frozen rule), final-test expectancy is -0.526%/trade. No evaluated configuration is genuinely profitable after real PSX V2 costs. Levers: richer data (genuine KSE-100 index, fundamentals with publication timestamps, intraday bars), longer horizons, regime-conditioned sizing.

PatchTST/N-BEATS/TimesNet/Informer/LSTM/GRU/CNN-LSTM/Transformer-LSTM/TabNet and Chronos/Lag-Llama/Moirai/Prophet/GARCH/Kalman not rerun on the pooled cohort — blocked by the 150s/2-CPU/4GB limit or missing packages; dispositions in task101_model_coverage.json.
GitHub push requires the owner PAT (the token lived only in a pre-recycle sandbox .git/config). Local commit prepared; push executes the moment credentials exist.
